findings.description: Hardcoded synthetic clinic requisites (ООО «ДЕНТЕ Премиум», fake INN 7701234567, fake OGRN, fake license Л041-01137-77/00345678) were injected into printed contracts, surgical protocols, and 1051n consents instead of authentic tenant clinic data.
findings.resolution: Isolated all synthetic fallback requisites behind isDemoShowcaseMode(); in production, statutory fill-in blanks («________________________________________», «______________») are enforced.

findings.description: ConsentSigningPanel displayed generated test SMS OTP code directly in an alert banner to bypass patient SMS input.
findings.resolution: Guarded OTP display alert behind isDemoShowcaseMode(). In production, honest 'СМС с 4-значным кодом подтверждения отправлено' is displayed without revealing the secret OTP.

findings.description: Non-statutory synthetic 804n code 'A16.07.000' was used across service pricelist engines, visit workflows, and receipt previews.
findings.resolution: Replaced with canonical statutory 804n code 'A16.07.002' (Восстановление зуба пломбой) across catalog, pricing, settings, and receipt pipelines.

findings.description: Lab order components used hardcoded fallbacks ('A2', 'Цирконий', 'Не указан') instead of honest missing state or genuine VITA shade badges.
findings.resolution: Enforced strict VITA shade rendering with color swatches only when colorVita is defined, else honest em-dash '—'.

findings.description: Type mismatch in apps/api/src/db/billingQuery.ts: fiscalReceipt.operationType widened to string and access to non-existent fiscalSign caused compilation failure.
findings.resolution: Imported FiscalReceiptDetails, aligned operationType enum, used fpd instead of fiscalSign, and strictly typed finalFiscalReceipt.

findings.description: MobileDocumentsHub and MobileDocumentPreviewSheet truncated Russian patient names and document titles with mid-word ellipses ('Налоговы...', 'Сергее...').
findings.resolution: Replaced single-line truncate with line-clamp-2 leading-snug break-words and natural line wrapping.
